## Checklist

- [ ] A failing test came first (TDD) — this PR adds behavior, and a test
      proves it.
- [ ] `bin/ci` is green locally.
- [ ] Structural changes (renames, extractions, moves) are in their own
      commit(s), separate from behavior changes.
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`,
      `chore:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`) and the PR title does too.
